notes: SUSHI has no pre-mine. 100% of supply is minted through MasterChef V1.
MasterChef V1 emits 100 SUSHI/block to LPs and 10 SUSHI/block to devaddr (110 total/block).
Both allocations are tracked onchain by indexing SUSHI mints to MasterChef and to devaddr.
SUSHI doesn't have a hard-capped max supply.

Liquidity Mining.methodology: Tracks SUSHI minted to MasterChef V1 for LP reward distribution. MasterChef emits sushiPerBlock (100 SUSHI) proportionally across pools by allocPoint.

masterchef-farming.name: MasterChef LP Rewards
masterchef-farming.methodology: SUSHI minted from zero address to MasterChef V1 contract, tracked via Transfer events

Development Fund.methodology: MasterChef V1 mints 10% of each pool's SUSHI reward to devaddr on every pool update.

dev-fund.name: Dev Fund Mints
dev-fund.methodology: SUSHI minted from zero address to devaddr, tracked via Transfer events.
